comparator.sourceNotes: Exact Dutch full-time BSc59329 Pedagogische Wetenschappen van Primair Onderwijs, ordinary three-year180EC route, distinct from general Pedagogical Sciences and ALPO. Current adopted2026–27 OER Article9.5 establishes35components:60+60+60EC,164required and16genuine academic choice replacing Analyse3(4EC B2) and optional diagnostic/treatment/advanced-professional courses(12EC B3). Optional replacements can affect later master orthopedagogical internship access; no universal master-admission promise. Required primary placements total33EC:8+8+7+10, across lower/middle/upper school years; didactics45EC and classroom-management5EC must be linked to a placement as Article9.5 specifies. Methods are cumulative academic skills, analysis, psychometrics and10EC individual theoretical/empirical educational thesis with APA7 and separate second assessment. Article8.2: normally B1 thenB2 thenB3; positive BSA permits certain B2 exams before allB1, B3 requires completeB1. AcademicSkills2 follows1; thesis follows2 plus timely preregistration. Stage2 followsStage1 and classroom management, Stage3 followsStage2, graduation stage followsStage3. AdvancedProfessionalSkills, if chosen, followsBasicSkills, requires preregistration and stage. BSA42EC. RADAr-NL is mandatory first year0EC with no exemption underArticle3.11; no invented additional credit. Attendance requirements are as specified in course manuals; actual placement/course activities and privacy training are integral without extra EC. Stage1 requires personal-data module, secure RU storage/no private mail forwarding; later stages/thesis specify confidentiality. Current thesis catalogue prose mentions retiredPWB2180 after the name AcademicSkills2; current OER8.2 unambiguously requires AcademicSkills2 and9.5 assigns currentPWB2320, whose2026 official header confirms the course. No old-code equivalence or waiver is asserted: current adopted named requirement governs. Prospective pages are provisional; replaced with adopted annual authority. No transitional exceptions are specified inArticle10.1.

exception.reason: UCR provides strong developmental psychology, psycholinguistics and research methods, together with genuine primary-school rhetoric teaching and a youth-education project. The proposed programme nonetheless centres on psychology, neuroscience and communication. It does not sustain PWPO’s defining breadth of primary-school subject didactics, classroom management and cumulative supervised teaching practice. Adding literary, social or general communication courses does not repair that missing instructional substance. No complete defensible UCR alternative is established; this finding is not based only on professional licensing.

exception.ucrCourseEvidence: The proposed180EC comprises82.5EC psychology/neuroscience,37.5EC research/statistics/data/qualitative/review methods,30EC rhetoric/style/persuasion including7.5EC actual primary-school rhetoric teaching,22.5EC sociology/human rights/political philosophy,7.5EC PPD. The youth-resilience project7.5EC adds genuine educational relevance. These contributions support a coherent child-development/language enquiry programme, but do not sustain the defining45EC subject didactics plus5EC classroom-management and33EC sequenced teaching-placement core of PWPO. This judgment concerns academic instructional substance and its weight, not merely the lack of a UCR teaching licence.

candidateAssessment.label: Child learning, rhetoric and school culture reconstruction
candidateAssessment.reason: Scanned all151 actual names/tracks/content for pedagogy, teaching, school, child and didactics. The strongest primary-school teaching and youth-educator contributions are already included. Read additional philosophy, literature, media and heritage profiles; literary children’s stories, general ethics, media analysis and ancient-democracy simulation do not supply reading/spelling/numeracy/handwriting/world-orientation/multilingual/art didactics and sequenced supervised teaching. No deep reading of all151 profiles is claimed. No complete defensible target response can be reconstructed by relabelling neighbouring courses.

audience.programmeDescription: PWPO at Radboud combines scientific study of children, learning and education with preparation to teach in primary schools. Subject didactics, classroom management and supervised school placements connect educational research with everyday teaching.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers useful developmental psychology, language research and research methods. It also provides a primary-school rhetoric teaching project and study of supportive school environments. These contributions do not sustain the broad subject didactics and cumulative supervised teaching practice at the centre of PWPO. We therefore show Radboud’s curriculum without presenting a UCR programme as a comparable alternative.

curriculum.limitation: The 180 EC programme has 164 EC of required study and 16 EC of academic choice: 4 EC in year 2 and 12 EC in year 3. Required placements total 33 EC and progress from supervised lessons to independent teaching. Subject didactics must accompany a placement. The 10 EC thesis has academic-skills and preregistration requirements. The first-year RADAr-NL language assessment is required without credits. Some optional course replacements can affect later master internship access. Radboud’s teaching qualification does not extend to the UCR courses described here.
